messages.content: My Vue 3 component loses its form state whenever I navigate to another route and back. I'm using the Composition API with refs inside the component.
Component-local refs are recreated when the route component is unmounted. Either wrap the router-view in KeepAlive or move the state into a Pinia store so it outlives the component.
A Pinia store sounds cleaner. Should I use the setup-store syntax or the options syntax, given the rest of the app is TypeScript?
Setup stores fit TypeScript and the Composition API best: define refs and functions in defineStore('form', () => {...}) and return them. Types are inferred automatically.
Great, I'll go with a setup store and add a reset() action for when the form is submitted.
